thread:
alex: Quick pulse — planning an 'Inference perf roundtable' to sync on recent benchmark results and optimization proposals. Proposed slots (all PT): Tue 10:00, Wed 15:00, Thu 09:00. Agenda (draft):
```
1) Benchmark readout: latency (p50/p95/p99), throughput, fail rates
2) Cost / token and cost / inference breakdown (hosted vs dedicated)
3) Optimization proposals: quantization, batching policy, KV/prefix caching effects
4) Rollout plan & canary strategy (model variants + fallback)
5) Action items and owners
```
Can folks +1 which slot works and volunteer to present sections? Prefer slides + dashboard links by EOD Fri.

priya: +1 for Tue 10:00. I can present throughput and cost-per-token slides. Will pull the nightly numbers and compare q4->q1 runs.

marco: Wed 15:00 works for me if that wins. I can run the tail-latency traces (p95/p99) and share flame graphs. Need latest trace collector flag enabled on canary (cc @eng-infra).

jen: Thu 09:00 is ok on my side. I can do the eval prompt set and quality regressions section — need the final prompt set in S3. Where should we dump artifacts?

samir: I'm tied up Tue morning but can join Wed afternoon. I think we should make the agenda explicit about Dedicated vs Hosted cost lines — different perf characteristics. Also propose a small A/B: quantized Llama-2 13B vs fp16 baseline for throughput/cost.

benchbot: nightly-bench summary uploaded: https://dash.redwood.internal/bench/2026-03-09 (summary: p50=34ms, p95=210ms, tokens=1.2M, cost est= $0.006/token). Full CSV at s3://redwood-inference/benchmarks/nightly/2026-03-09.csv

alex: thanks. Jen — use s3://redwood-inference/benchmarks/roundtable-2026-03 for slides + prompts. I'll create folders: /slides, /raw-csv, /traces.

priya: FYI I'll include a small appendix comparing batching configs (max_batch=64 vs 128) and the KV cache hit rate. If we want a quick demo of prefix caching, I can show token savings on a short convo.

marco: cc @eng-infra: can you ensure trace sampling is at 5% for the canary pool before Tue? I only need short windows but need sampling to be on.

samir: +1 to the canary request. Also recommend we add an explicit "regressions to watch" slide (prompt-level examples). Avoid surprise rollbacks.

jen: I'll upload the eval set by Friday EOD to s3 path Alex created. Will also list repro prompts for any potential regressions.

alex: Polling votes so we can lock: 
- Tue 10:00: priya :+1:, alex :+1:
- Wed 15:00: marco :+1:, samir :+1:
- Thu 09:00: jen :+1:
Seems split. Leaning Tue 10:00 so throughput/cost data flows into the rest of the week. If anyone strongly opposes, speak now.

samir: I can't do Tue morning — if we need my input on dedicated vs hosted, please record. Otherwise fine to defer to follow-up session.

alex: ok locking Tue 10:00 PT. I'll send a calendar invite with Zoom + link to the dashboards. Agenda deadline: slides + dashboards linked in S3 by Friday 17:00 PT.

priya: noted. I'll put a short README in the S3 folder with commands to reproduce the throughput runs.

marco: will prepare the traces and a short section on tail fixes (locking down straggler sources).

jen: uploading eval prompts tomorrow, will add quality checks and a short A/B template.

alex: owners assigned:
- Throughput & cost: priya
- Tail latency & traces: marco
- Quality/regressions: jen
- Canary + rollout plan: samir (if not available, alex will cover)

alex: last ask — attach one slide with clear go/no-go criteria for any rollout (latency thresholds, cost delta, user-impact examples). We want decisions, not just numbers.

benchbot: reminder: nightly bench will run at 02:00 PT. I will post updated CSVs to the S3 path after completion.

jen: thanks all — I'll add my section and ping if I need help with reproductions.

alex: thanks everyone. Invite incoming. See you Tue. :rocket:
